text:
liz (AE): Starting ContourBank POC thread. Requirements: SAML SSO (Okta primary, Microsoft Entra secondary), SCIM provisioning (users + multi-level groups), RBAC where groups map to tenant-scoped roles, domain ownership verification for org assertions, and an option for private VPC deployment because of PHI. Buyer wants feasibility, a short onboarding runbook, and a high-level Dedicated vs Private cost delta by EOD Friday. Looping in @connor and @amira.

connor (SE): Quick clarifying Qs: do they want SP-initiated only or both SP and IdP? Any requirement for OIDC client credentials for service-to-service? Also, expected size of initial directory (users + groups)? This affects SCIM bulk strategy.

amira (Solutions Eng): They specified both SP and IdP SAML flows. No OIDC for authn right now, but they will call our admin APIs using mTLS from a staging host during cutover. Directory size: ~18k users and ~2k groups; cutover plan shows a ~40 req/s sustained SCIM import window for ~3 hours.

diego (Security): Privacy/reg compliance notes: PHI means we must support tenant-level encryption keys and provide audit exports to their Splunk instance. If they insist on HSM-backed keys, procurement + infra provisioning is ~3-6 weeks. Need to confirm if encryption-at-rest with customer-managed KMS is sufficient. Also ask whether MFA assertions need to be preserved in logs or redacted.

liz (AE): Pricing ask from buyer: committed usage estimate is 6M tokens/mo plus heavy embeddings usage on specific routes; plus initial provisioning with 18k users. They want to know uplift for Dedicated reserved capacity and a separate quote for Private host + support. Also want one-off onboarding fee for SCIM ingestion support if we run the import.

connor (SE): High-level: Dedicated = baseline + premium for SLA and reserved GPU pools. Private = license + support + infra ops; typically Private has a higher upfront onboarding fee but lower marginal token cost only if they run large volumes on their hardware. For SCIM: we offer three onboarding paths:
1) Customer-run bulk CSV -> our bulk ingestion API (no hour-level rate change)
2) Short-lived SCIM burst increase (requires Ops window + 48h notice)
3) Dedicated ingestion job via our onboarding team (managed, additional fee)

amira (Solutions Eng): Technical notes we should include in runbook: how to validate SAML cert rotation, how to configure group->role transformations (we support prefix/suffix mapping and regex capture groups), recommended SCIM chunk sizing for large users (batch size ~500 users), and the ephemeral rate increase gating policy. I'll draft a one-pager with example curl snippets.

connor (SE): Example transform (we'll give this in the doc):

```
# transform Okta group "dept-eng-west" -> role "eng-west"
transform: {
  "type": "regex",
  "pattern": "^dept-(.*)$",
  "template": "\\1"
}
```

And suggested SCIM chunking guidance (as text in the runbook): send batches of 250-500 users, keep average payload ~2KB/user to avoid large memory spikes. For the cutover burst we support up to 50 req/s for 3 hours if scheduled with Ops 48h in advance; Ops will require a manual safety cutoff.

diego (Security): Also add checklist items: required SOC2 evidence, recommended SIEM endpoints (HTTP event collector + syslog fallback), minimum retention options (90d vs 365d), and if they want assertion-level telemetry forwarded we need an ingestion contract for storage.

liz (AE): Can we commit to that 50 req/s/3h window in writing as part of the POC addendum? Buyer wants that spelled out. Also they asked whether domain verification can be automated via DNS TXT proof or must be emailed cert.

amira (Solutions Eng): We can include a POC addendum offering a one-time temporary rate increase to 50 req/s for up to 3 hours per cutover, subject to Ops approval and a 48h notice; cost estimate is roughly 1.15x for that onboarding period to cover ops time and temporary infra headroom. Domain verification: we support DNS TXT and email token methods; DNS TXT is preferred and fastest.

connor (SE): I'm going to run a quick capacity sim with their payload assumptions (2KB/user, 400 group memberships average) and confirm whether 50 req/s maintains latency SLAs. If not, we fallback to managed ingestion. ETA for sim: 24 hours.

infra-bot: deploy:private-deploy-package-3.9.0.tar.gz uploaded. Note: current private build supports customer-managed KMS integrations and SCIM bulk endpoint + group transforms.

diego (Security): One more: if they want per-assertion logging forwarded with PII, we need to provide redaction options in the logging pipeline; that'll be part of the compliance scoping doc.

liz (AE): Action items: @amira draft runbook + example mappings and SCIM chunking guidance by EOD tomorrow; @connor run perf sim and share 1-page capacity + whether 50 req/s is safe; @diego produce minimal compliance checklist (KMS/HSM options, SIEM endpoints, retention tiers). I'll package into a single doc for the buyer and ask for a sample SCIM CSV and preferred cutover windows. :thumbsup:

amira (Solutions Eng): I'll include sample curl requests and a short diagram showing SAML flow, SCIM bulk flow, and where domain verification fits.

liz (AE): Thanks team. I'll schedule a follow-up call with ContourBank to walk through the runbook once we have perf numbers.

connor (SE): FYI I'll need the sample CSV to validate chunking. DM me.

liz (AE): Will request it today.

infra-bot: ticket#7891 created: "Onboarding capacity window - ContourBank" assigned to oncall-ops.
